\chapter{Boolean Analysis — Definitions}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Definitions
\section{Overview}
Gaussian rotation sensitivity and its extended surface-area limit are defined here, together with the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside the open probability interval.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Gaussian rotation sensitivity]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.rotationSensitivity}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.standardGaussianMeasure}
\statementsource{boolean-ch11-gaussian-invariance}{pdf-8b2c50cf9621-p016-b001}
Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. For any set $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ and real $t$, its rotation sensitivity is the real value of the product-measure mass of the event $\mathbf1_A(G)\ne\mathbf1_A(\cos t\,G+\sin t\,G\prime)$; for measurable $A$, this is the disagreement probability.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Surface area from infinitesimal rotations]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.gaussianSurfaceArea}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.rotationSensitivity}
\statementsource{boolean-ch11-gaussian-invariance}{pdf-8b2c50cf9621-p019-b001}
\statementsource{mossel-neeman-gaussian-noise-stability}{
  pdf-b53c1a5aa27d-p006-b003,
  pdf-b53c1a5aa27d-p006-b004
}
Let $n\ge0$, let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$, and let $G,G\prime$ be independent vectors with law $\gamma_n$. Write $s_A(t)$ for the real value of the product-measure mass $(\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n)\{(g,h):\mathbf1_A(g)\ne\mathbf1_A(\cos t\,g+\sin t\,h)\}$. For any $A\subseteq\mathbb R^n$, its Gaussian surface area is the extended nonnegative quantity $P_\gamma(A)=\liminf_{t\to0^+}[\sqrt{\pi/2}\,s_A(t)/t]_+$, where $[u]_+=\max(u,0)$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Gaussian profile with zero endpoints]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.gaussianIsoperimetric}
\statementsource{boolean-ch11-gaussian-invariance}{
  pdf-8b2c50cf9621-p019-b002,
  pdf-8b2c50cf9621-p021-b001
}
\statementsource{mossel-neeman-gaussian-noise-stability}{pdf-b53c1a5aa27d-p006-b004}
For a real number $\alpha$, the closed Gaussian profile is $U(\alpha)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(\alpha))$ if $0<\alpha<1$, and $U(\alpha)=0$ otherwise, where $\varphi$ and $\Phi$ are the standard Gaussian density and distribution function.
\end{definition}
